scientific_purpose: Connect prior AP/LB reversals to ranking, full-pool operating decisions and inference-scale changes. Refit actual historical Morgan recipes and the new network on the exact historical outer assignments; compare against retained complete September-15 and failed-AP ensemble predictions on matching splits.
threshold_policy: Train-only inner grouped CV selects bootstrap mean MCC threshold over inner-score quantiles; no call-count constraint or fixed prevalence
candidate_intent: Produce a reviewed prospective classification probe from independent models and explicit decision-policy evidence, including uncertainty; uncertainty is quantified rather than an automatic rejection gate.
limits: Individual hidden labels cannot be inferred from aggregate Live metrics. Historical full-ensemble OOF data are retrospective controls, not relabelled as a new split or used as features. A specific payload approval is required before upload.
